001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.MatchType;
004import org.bukkit.World;
005import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
006import org.bukkit.util.BoundingBox;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.UUID;
010
011public interface Match extends Spectatable {
012
013    /**
014     * Get the players of the match.
015     * @return The players of the match
016     */
017    List<Player> getPlayers();
018
019    /**
020     * Get the spectators of the match.
021     * @return The spectators of the match
022     */
023    List<Player> getSpectators();
024
025    /**
026     * Get the amount of wins needed to win the match.
027     * @return The amount of wins needed to win the match
028     */
029    int getWinsNeeded();
030
031    /**
032     * Get the ladder name of the match.
033     * @return The ladder name of the match, or null if not set
034     */
035    String getLadderName();
036
037    /**
038     * Get the ladder display name of the match.
039     * @return The ladder display name of the match, or null if not set
040     */
041    String getLadderDisplayName();
042
043    /**
044     * Get the unique id of the match.
045     * @return The match id, never null
046     * @since 2.4.0
047     */
048    default String getMatchId() {
049        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * Get the name of the arena the match is played in.
054     * @return The arena name, never null
055     * @since 2.4.0
056     */
057    default String getArenaName() {
058        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
059    }
060
061    /**
062     * Check whether the match is ranked.
063     * @return true if the match is ranked
064     * @since 2.4.0
065     */
066    default boolean isRanked() {
067        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Get the type of the match.
072     * @return The match type, never null; {@link MatchType#UNKNOWN} for types added by a newer core version
073     * @since 2.4.0
074     */
075    default MatchType getMatchType() {
076        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
077    }
078
079    /**
080     * Get how long the match has been running.
081     * @return The duration in seconds
082     * @since 2.4.0
083     */
084    default int getDurationSeconds() {
085        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
086    }
087
088    /**
089     * Get the current round number.
090     * @return The current round number, 1-based
091     * @since 2.4.0
092     */
093    default int getCurrentRoundNumber() {
094        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * Get the inventory snapshots of every player in every finished round. Main thread only.
099     * Snapshots of a round are available from MatchRoundEndEvent of that round, and all of them from MatchEndEvent.
100     * @return An unmodifiable list sorted by round number, never null. Players offline at round end are missing.
101     * @since 2.6.0
102     */
103    default List<RoundInventory> getRoundInventories() {
104        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.6.0+");
105    }
106
107    /**
108     * Get the inventory snapshots of one player in every finished round. Main thread only.
109     * @param player The player's unique id
110     * @return An unmodifiable list sorted by round number, never null
111     * @since 2.6.0
112     */
113    default List<RoundInventory> getRoundInventories(UUID player) {
114        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.6.0+");
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * Get the inventory snapshot of one player in one round. Main thread only.
119     * @param player The player's unique id
120     * @param round The round number, 1-based
121     * @return The snapshot, or null if none was saved for that player and round
122     * @since 2.6.0
123     */
124    default RoundInventory getRoundInventory(UUID player, int round) {
125        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.6.0+");
126    }
127
128    /**
129     * Get the name of the arena the match was asked for. For a match in an arena copy this is the original arena.
130     * @return The original arena name, never null
131     * @since 2.11.0
132     */
133    default String getOriginalArenaName() {
134        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.11.0+");
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * Get the world of the arena the match is played in.
139     * @return The arena world, never null
140     * @since 2.11.0
141     */
142    default World getArenaWorld() {
143        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.11.0+");
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * Get the box covering every block of the arena the match is played in. The upper corner is exclusive.
148     * @return The arena bounds, never null
149     * @since 2.11.0
150     */
151    default BoundingBox getArenaBounds() {
152        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.11.0+");
153    }
154
155    /**
156     * Check whether the match is played in a build arena or an arena copy. Such arenas host one match at a time.
157     * @return true for a build arena or an arena copy
158     * @since 2.11.0
159     */
160    default boolean isBuildArena() {
161        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.11.0+");
162    }
163
164    /**
165     * Get the bot bodies taking part in the match. Empty for matches without bots.
166     * @return The bot bodies of the match, never null
167     * @since 2.11.0
168     */
169    default List<Player> getBotBodies() {
170        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.11.0+");
171    }
172
173}
